config.text: Channel: Slack (team workspace). Reply guidance: professional and concise — Slack is a workplace tool, not a casual chat. Slack uses mrkdwn (a near-Markdown variant): *bold*, _italic_, ~strike~, `code`, ```block code```, and `> quote` work; standard Markdown headings (#) and bullet syntax (-) do NOT — use plain numbered lines or hyphens at the start of a line for lists. Keep replies focused: lead with the answer, then supporting detail. Threaded replies stay short; channel-wide messages can be more thorough. Avoid emoji unless the surrounding conversation uses them.
